title: GENESIS packet index
description: Hash-bound pointer list of every packets/<id>.json in this repository. The index is not the contract — each packet file is. Maintained by whoever merges a packet change. Shape is the one packets/INDEX.json already uses: a named schema, a description, an updatedAt timestamp, and an array of {id, status, path, sha256} entries whose sha256 is 64 lowercase hex characters.

description.description: What this index is for, in plain language. Not a second copy of the packets.

updatedAt.description: When this index file was last rewritten to match the packet files it lists.

entry.description: One row. id, status, and path must match the on-disk packet; sha256 is the hash of that file's exact bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the packet file bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters.
